name: cx-goal-one-rule~p2
task: Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Open the door, then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task commands 'Open the door, then pick up the box in the other room' — this requires hard Existence(door_open), Existence(target_picked_up) and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up), which are all missing; only the soft Absence(key_lost) clause is present, so nothing makes the door open or the box picked up and FINAL_STATES is empty. Add the hard goal/order clauses for opening the door and then picking up the target box, and keep the soft Absence(key_lost): the wording 'try not to' makes it a preference, and key_lost's own definition already ties it to the door being closed.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: the soft Absence(key_lost) captures 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' (key_lost already encodes the closed-door condition, so no Precedence is needed), and Existence(door_open) hard, Existence(target_picked_up) hard, and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) hard capture the ordered command; the pair Existence/Precedence makes the earlier Existence(door_open) necessary rather than redundant since target_picked_up alone would not force door_open, and 'try not to' correctly makes the absence soft.

texts: It is not allowed to have key_lost while door_open has not yet happened
It is required to reach door_open
It is required to reach target_picked_up
